round.body:
School’s out. Fun is on. ☀️

Give your kiddo a summer camp filled with movement, games, crafts, themed activities, and new friendships.

🤸 Active play
🎨 Creative fun
😄 Big smiles
🚫 Less screen time
👯 New friends and big summer energy

Each week brings a new theme, fresh activities, and full days packed with fun. Campers get to enjoy gym time, games, arts and crafts, and special themes each week that keep the experience feeling different and exciting all summer long. No membership required to attend.

selva.body:
Imagine a day in the Amazon like this:

Morning birdwatching from the canopy observation tower.

Afternoon canoe ride across a quiet lagoon.

Evening wildlife sightings during a night excursion. 🌙

At La Selva Eco-Lodge & Retreat, every experience connects you deeper to the rainforest.

Highlights include:

🦜 Parrot clay lick visits
 🌿 Jungle trail exploration
 🛶 Canoeing & kayaking
 🐢 Charapa turtle conservation program
 🌌 Stargazing beneath the Amazon sky

And always returning to beautiful suites and remarkable cuisine.

Learn more and check available travel dates.

https://laselvajunglelodge.com/activities/
selva.headline: Your Gateway to the Amazon Rainforest
